baseline.note: Production snapshot captured read-only. Campaign duration has n=12; assistant and quick_tool have no completed duration sample, so superiority cannot be claimed from those historical cohorts alone.

breakpoints.note: The participant created an empty client profile named C01 instead of selecting the supplied Horizonte Educacao brand, so the campaign entered the workspace without the intended brand context.
Campaign workspace froze while the mounted assistant panel repeatedly posted the default-thread request; the server observed a sustained request loop.

journeys.observerNotes: Human participant reported 'travou aqui'. Campaign creation itself returned 201; the failure occurred after entering the campaign workspace. Local cold compilation was excluded from the breakpoint.

breakpoints.note: The workspace called missing product/offer and later QA findings 'blocking problems', but exposed no place to answer or resolve them; those blockers ultimately prevented export. The participant expected advisory guidance, not a dead end.
The feedback modal asked about the preview before any preview or generated output had been shown.
The loading animation rendered overlapping logo glyphs, visibly colliding in the center of the output card.

The participant did not perform an explicit pilot approval before the full batch appeared: Peça 1 low quality, Peça 1 high quality, then Peça 2 and Peça 3 high quality. Preview and production versions were not distinguishable as a controlled approval sequence.
Rejecting required a direction of at least eight characters, while the displayed blocking QA findings had no response or remediation surface.
The campaign chat persisted the message 'Teste de chat.' but returned only the raw token assistantStreamError and no assistant response.
Generated creatives inserted CENBRAP branding, a March promotion and payment claims such as up to 20 installments without supported brand or offer context.
Format adaptations visibly bled or cropped information instead of preserving hierarchy and safe areas across the requested dimensions.

The delivery stage showed an empty derivation area and blocking brief copy despite the campaign having generated and approved outputs; it did not summarize recent generations or make completed work visible.

journeys.observerNotes: The intended Horizonte Educacao context was not actually attached: the campaign persisted an empty profile named C01. Eight screenshots are preserved under docs/plans/phase8-human-evidence/c01-before. Database evidence shows one preview, three 1:1 production outputs and four format adaptations; the campaign reached completed, two outputs were approved, chat stored one user message with no assistant reply, and no delivery was completed.

breakpoints.note: The participant could reach Templates only by entering the URL directly; no discoverable route to the surface was found in the desktop interface.

The materialized campaign displayed a completed briefing and an enabled 'Continuar para acoes' button, but clicking it did not advance without a base image. The UI did not explain that the image was required, and uploading an arbitrary image would invalidate the template workflow.

journeys.observerNotes: The template materialized campaign d2f1c307-1dee-4d84-bc45-9692812bc43d with the expected product, offer, audience, platforms and Horizonte Educacao profile. Database evidence shows zero assets and zero derivations. Clicking continue emitted stage telemetry but made no generation request or useful transition. The screenshot was captured at desktop width although the planned C02 matrix called for mobile; this failed attempt does not count toward the completed sample.

breakpoints.note: The participant asked whether typing the seeded brand name into the free-text Client field was the correct way to associate a brand profile; the creation modal did not explain the relationship.
The generated briefing copied the client name into product and offer, then fabricated an objective and audience from that name instead of using the seeded Cafe Aurora brand context.

With no arbitrary base image uploaded, repeated clicks on the enabled 'Continuar para acoes' button emitted completion telemetry but produced no generation request, output or useful stage transition. The participant waited four minutes.
The mounted campaign assistant showed the raw error 'signal timed out' while the participant was blocked in the briefing stage.

journeys.observerNotes: Campaign 7c38fe41-9d2e-4d55-b557-5eaba5279385 correctly linked the existing Cafe Aurora client profile, but persisted the client name as product and offer plus generic generated objective/audience. Database evidence shows zero assets and zero derivations. The participant supplied no arbitrary image, received no output and could not progress beyond briefing.

breakpoints.note: On mobile, the campaign Chat tab stayed indefinitely on 'Iniciando conversa...' and never exposed an input. No assistant thread request reached the server and no thread was persisted.

journeys.observerNotes: The seeded Studio Pulso campaign had complete product, objective, audience, offer and brand profile context. The participant could not send the first message because initialization never completed. Server logs show the campaign, brand-kit, assets and derivations reads, but no POST to create an assistant thread; the database still contains zero threads for this campaign.

breakpoints.note: The campaign appeared as a recent task, but opening it returned to an empty briefing state with no asset, derivation or prior output to resume. The seeded scenario did not expose meaningful work-in-progress.

Manually entering Produzir exposed generation, but 'Gerar variacoes' ended with the toast 'Falha ao enfileirar previa'. The campaign remained art_variation with zero base assets, and the UI offered no explanation or recovery path.
The campaign assistant again remained on 'Iniciando conversa...' throughout the attempt. A thread endpoint returned, but no assistant thread or messages were persisted for the campaign.

journeys.observerNotes: Campaign 07fff179-686f-4362-9d69-4677612e982e had correct Cafe Aurora briefing fields and brand context, but was seeded as an art_variation draft with zero assets and zero derivations. The participant could navigate directly to Produzir, yet preview enqueue failed and delivery remained unreachable. Database evidence after the attempt still shows zero assets, zero derivations and zero assistant threads.

breakpoints.note: After selecting the seeded Horizonte Educacao brand, the participant still had to ask what to enter for theme, objective, audience and offer; the brand context supplied no defaults or suggestions.

The copy endpoint generated and persisted headline, body and CTA, but the wizard advanced to Copy with all three fields blank and Avancar enabled. A full page refresh was required to recover the persisted result.

At enqueue, each output ID was published with a creativeLevel different from the level stored on that same output row: conservative mapped to a row labeled balanced, balanced to bold, and bold to conservative.

All three generation jobs started, but after more than six minutes none completed or failed. The work remained generating and every proposal remained processing with no output key, cost or failure code.

journeys.observerNotes: Creative work 8728db84-8357-42cd-9902-fd4e7113bc75 persisted the correct brief and generated copy. Refresh recovered the copy and allowed identity confirmation, after which three events were received by Inngest. The server logged each canonical generation start but no completion or failure. Database evidence shows the work still generating and all three outputs indefinitely processing.

breakpoints.note: Creating copy returned the raw client error 'signal timed out' even though headline, body and CTA were persisted. A full refresh was again required to recover the result.
The output IDs were again enqueued with creative levels different from their persisted rows, reproducing the conservative-to-balanced, balanced-to-bold and bold-to-conservative rotation.

OpenAI successfully generated all three candidate images, but each Inngest function failed afterward. The work remained generating and all outputs remained processing with no final output key, cost or failure code.

journeys.observerNotes: Creative work f73703cb-8707-4383-a20d-6d15b51ff807 persisted the correct 9:16 Cafe Aurora brief and copy. Refresh recovered the copy, then three generation events were published. OpenAI returned a candidate for every output (44.7s, 45.8s and 74.9s), while Seedream was unavailable due missing BYTEPLUS_API_KEY. All three functions subsequently failed and left the work and output rows non-terminal. Provider work was consumed without a user-visible deliverable or recorded cost.

breakpoints.note: The standalone Assistant opened with the raw error 'signal timed out' before the participant could send a first message. No thread was selected or created, the server did not complete a thread POST, and the database contained zero assistant threads for the Studio Pulso profile.

journeys.observerNotes: The primary standalone Assistant surface failed while establishing the conversation, before any user message or model generation. No assistant thread, message, provider call or cost was persisted, so the participant had no recovery path inside the surface.

breakpoints.note: Selecting the seeded Studio Pulso brand again left theme, objective, audience and offer entirely blank, requiring external guidance before the participant could proceed.

Creating copy returned the raw error 'signal timed out' and left the mobile wizard on Briefing, although the database contained the generated headline, body and CTA. Continuing would require a manual refresh that hides the failed client state.

journeys.observerNotes: Creative work b46ef338-c12c-4ebc-891d-327a0e80568d persisted the correct Studio Pulso 4:5 brief and generated copy, but the UI did not receive or hydrate that result. The attempt was stopped before identity confirmation to avoid repeating the provider-cost-without-delivery failure already demonstrated in N02.

breakpoints.note: Home correctly linked 'Continuar de onde parei' to the Cafe Aurora work ID, but the destination rendered a new empty Briefing with no selected brand, fields or recovered progress. The database still held the original brief, copy, generating status and three processing outputs.
On resume, the work remained generating and all three outputs remained processing with no output key, cost or failure code, despite the three successful provider generations observed during N02.

journeys.observerNotes: Home selected the correct work f73703cb-8707-4383-a20d-6d15b51ff807, but resume did not hydrate any persisted state after more than five minutes. The empty form contradicted the database, which retained the full 9:16 brief and copy plus three non-terminal outputs. No useful action or recovery path was exposed.

breakpoints.note: The participant described the mandatory campaign shell as tedious before reaching the creative work itself. The flow required navigating campaign structure before any useful creative output existed.

Without a base image, 'Continuar para acoes' did not advance, but clicking the Produzir stage bypassed that gate and exposed generation controls. The two navigation paths enforce contradictory prerequisites.

After entering Produzir through the stage control, 'Gerar variacoes' returned 'Falha ao enfileirar previa'. The API returned 400, while the campaign remained a draft with zero assets and zero derivations.

journeys.observerNotes: Campaign 07ff1668-fa80-478d-9c98-56bc3ffff9d8 was persisted and the campaign Assistant successfully created thread 9befaf85-dbe8-4bcc-95f6-6a61c5c90b5f, confirming the assistant-timeout correction. A local Next.js memory restart caused one transient ChunkLoadError and was recovered; the final product failure was independently reproduced afterward with a stable server.

corrections.description: Prevent the mounted campaign assistant panel from issuing another default-thread POST while the same campaign/profile request is already in flight.
Give assistant thread creation enough time to complete instead of exposing the generic 15-second client abort as a permanent startup failure.
Allow synchronous copy generation to outlive the generic request timeout while preserving the returned server snapshot in the query cache.
Keep generated image buffers out of Inngest step output and reload the stored base only when exact-layer composition needs it.
Derive the active Create Post work from the current URL so client navigation between resumable works hydrates the requested aggregate.
